extracted.intended_audience: Learners, families, and educators in Phoenix, AZ seeking accredited Korean language classes (preschool through adult, heritage speakers, and high school students)

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accreditation is presented as a quality marker and is used to support issuing transcripts for high school credit; implies institutional recognition and transferability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heritage Korean language education
